name: Saijou Yayoi
source:
Shirogane Academy special curriculum 1st year high school student.
Member of the light music club. Vocalist in their band 'Blue Bird'.

Special Skills: Singing, Magic Tricks
Favorite Phrase: Self-denial is poison to the body
Likes: Silver Accessories
Dislikes: Bell Peppers
